reviews.comment:
Soy socio del ACA y hace algunos años dejé de parar en esta estación de servicio por varios motivos: mala atención, nunca con sistema, baños desastrosos; hoy quise probar y debo decir que cambió todo, playero excelente, todas las tarjetas con su ticket respectivo y baños impecables (con jabón, papel, secamanos y canillas funcionando diez puntos). Puedo recomendarla.

(Translated by Google)
I'm a member of the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina) and a few years ago I stopped stopping at this gas station for several reasons: poor service, the system was never working, and the restrooms were terrible. Today I decided to try it again, and I must say everything has changed. The attendant was excellent, all cards were accepted with their respective receipts, and the restrooms were spotless (with soap, paper towels, hand dryers, and faucets working perfectly). I can recommend it.
